guarantees.claim: At simulation start, perm_test is assigned a bitmask with '1' at each index RndCnstLfsrPerm[k] for k from 0 to EntropyOutputW-1, then assertion PermutationCheck_A verifies that all bits of perm_test are '1', confirming the permutation covers all positions.

uncertain_points.claim: If EntropyOutputW exceeds the length of the RndCnstLfsrPerm array, the loop will read out-of-bounds elements of RndCnstLfsrPerm, causing X or compilation errors.
uncertain_points.risk: Simulation or synthesis may use undefined values, potentially corrupting the entropy permutation path.

uncertain_points.claim: The permutation check assertion runs only once at time 0 and will not detect runtime errors if RndCnstLfsrPerm or EntropyOutputW are dynamically changed (though they are likely constants).
uncertain_points.cond: if parameters can be modified after time 0
uncertain_points.risk: A silent corruption of the permutation map could go undetected during normal operation, affecting entropy distribution.
